summary: Iteration 14 — validated the CLIENT-SIDE filtering refactor for Relay Dip. All 8 requested scenarios pass end-to-end from the deployed public URL. Confirmed via network interception that ONLY ONE GET /api/points is fired at mount (plus /api/carriers and /api/auth/me). Filters (carrier chips, type, search, radius), search-suggest selection, and admin CRUD callbacks all operate on the in-memory allPoints state without re-fetching /api/points. Admin CRUD regressions (add/edit/delete) reflect immediately in the results count (4127 → 4128 → 4127) and in the point-detail modal, still without any additional GET /api/points. Auth persists after full page reload; logout hides admin UI.

critical_code_review_comments: MapApp.js: points useMemo (l.98-123) correctly recomputes distance only when userLoc set; filter is O(N) over 4127 items which is fine at this size. Good.
MapApp.js:266 listPoints = visiblePoints.slice(0, 300) — matches spec (300 max). truncation note only shown for tab!=='nearby' which makes sense because nearby is already radius-limited.
MapApp.js:701-717 onSaved/onDeleted callbacks correctly patch allPoints in place — this is what enables immediate carte/liste updates without a refetch.
PointCard.js is exported as React.memo(PointCard) — good, prevents unnecessary re-renders across 300 list items when filters flip.
MapView.js ClusterLayer rebuilds when the memoized 'points' prop identity changes — this is intentional and required so cluster markers reflect the active filter.
Backend GET /api/points/{id} still doesn't honor _DELETED (carried from iter13 minor). Not exercised by this refactor since the frontend never fetches by id.
Minor: mount fires /api/carriers, /api/points, /api/auth/me concurrently (good). If /api/auth/me is 401 for guests it logs 'Failed to load resource 401' in console — expected behavior, not a bug.
test_credentials: Admin admin@relaispoint.fr / admin123 works — persists on reload via httpOnly cookie.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one transient custom point (name TEST_ITER14_<ts>) during admin CRUD regression. Final state is back to baseline (4127 points, no orphan cust-* remaining).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Client-side filter refactor verified. Interception counts: initial mount = 3 API calls (/api/carriers, /api/points, /api/auth/me); every filter toggle/search/radius change = 0 API calls. Admin CRUD writes to /api/admin/points ONCE each and mutates in-memory allPoints via onSaved/onDeleted (no /api/points refetch). Testids used: carrier-filter-{id}, type-filter-{all|relais|locker}, search-input, search-suggestions, suggest-item-{postal}, tab-{all|nearby|favorites}, nearby-address-input, nearby-address-btn, radius-slider, radius-value, results-count, point-card-*, point-detail, fav-btn-*, header-add-point-btn, point-form, form-{name,address,postal,city,lat,lng,save-btn,delete-btn,delete-confirm-btn}, detail-edit-btn, detail-delete-btn, detail-delete-confirm-btn, logout-btn, open-auth-btn, change-password-btn, auth-modal, auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-btn. No new bugs found; refactor is production-ready.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — refactor is functioning as specified. Confirmed no /api/points refetch on any filter/search/CRUD event.
